objects.name: Orders & transactions
objects.from: POS, QR menu, kiosk, web store, ride-hailing apps
objects.create: Nobody in back office. Cashier / guest / platform at the point of sale
objects.edit: Never. Corrections are a void or refund linked to the original
objects.auto: Stock deducts by recipe · loyalty points · tax · commission · tips · sales reports
objects.closed: Back office has no “+ New” or edit on transactions; a sale only exists if it was rung up

objects.name: Payments & settlement
objects.from: POS tenders, QRIS / VA / card gateway, EDC
objects.create: Nobody. Created when a tender succeeds
objects.edit: Never. Gateway status updates itself (pending → paid → settled)
objects.approve: Manual “paid by transfer”: cashier attaches proof → PIC ≤ 100k → Manager ≤ 500k → Owner
objects.auto: Settlement report · reconciliation · cash flow
objects.closed: No manual “mark as paid” without proof and a second person; mismatches raise an alert, they can’t be edited away

objects.name: Voids
objects.from: Started by the cashier at the POS before payment
objects.approve: PIC ≤ IDR 100k · Manager ≤ 500k · Owner above
objects.escalate: PIC 5 min → Manager 30 min → Owner. Never auto-approved; expires at shift end
objects.auto: Ticket recalled from KDS · stock returned if not cooked
objects.closed: After payment a void is impossible, it becomes a refund. Limits are per order and add up, so splitting doesn’t dodge them

objects.name: Refunds
objects.from: Started at the POS (or the platform for ride-hailing orders)
objects.create: Cashier / PIC (request). Ride-hailing refunds are decided by the platform
objects.approve: PIC ≤ IDR 100k · Manager ≤ 500k · Owner above (and any refund to a different method than paid)
objects.escalate: PIC 5 min → Manager 30 min → Owner 2 h
objects.auto: Payment reversed · points removed · stock back if returned · alert if one person refunds a lot
objects.closed: Refund goes to the original method; cash refund for a QRIS/card sale needs owner. Requester can never approve their own

objects.name: Discounts & comps
objects.from: Applied at the POS
objects.approve: Cashier up to 10% · PIC ≤ 20% · Manager above · comp (100%) Manager · Owner sets the caps
objects.auto: Margin report · discount report
objects.closed: Open price only on items flagged “open price”; otherwise any price change at the POS is a discount and follows this chain

objects.name: Cash in / cash out (petty cash)
objects.from: POS drawer, entered by cashier with reason and photo of the receipt
objects.approve: PIC ≤ IDR 100k · Manager ≤ 500k · Owner above
objects.auto: Becomes an expense automatically · drawer expected amount updates
objects.closed: No cash out without a photo of the receipt and a category

objects.name: Drawer sessions & variance
objects.from: POS shift open / close with blind count
objects.create: Nobody. Opened and closed at the POS
objects.edit: Count is locked after submit; a recount adds a new line, both kept
objects.approve: Variance ≤ IDR 50k PIC signs · ≤ 500k Manager · above Owner
objects.escalate: Unsigned at day close → Manager → Owner next morning
objects.auto: Daily cash reconciliation · variance report · alerts
objects.closed: Counter never sees the expected amount and never signs their own count

objects.name: Tips
objects.from: Guest adds a tip at payment (POS, QR, customer display)
objects.approve: Distribution rule: Owner
objects.auto: Split to staff by rule · goes to payroll
objects.closed: Tips can’t be moved between people by hand; the rule decides

objects.name: Expenses
objects.from: Typed by manager / owner, plus automatic lines from petty cash, paid supplier bills and subscriptions
objects.edit: Creator until approved; after that only Owner with reason
objects.approve: Manager-entered expense > IDR 500k → Owner
objects.escalate: Owner 24 h, reminder in WA digest
objects.auto: P&L · cash flow · budget vs actual
objects.closed: Every manual expense needs a receipt photo; duplicates (same amount, supplier, day) are flagged

objects.name: Supplier bills & payables
objects.from: Created when goods are received against a PO
objects.create: Nobody types a bill; it comes from goods receipt
objects.edit: Owner can correct amount with invoice photo
objects.approve: Paying a bill: Owner (bank) · Manager may pay from drawer ≤ IDR 500k as cash out
objects.auto: Cash flow · supplier balance · price-increase alert
objects.closed: No bill without a received PO, so a fake supplier can’t be paid

objects.name: Bank accounts & withdrawals
objects.from: Owner settings
objects.edit: Owner only, with 2FA; new account has a 24 h hold and WA + email notice
objects.auto: Settlement payouts
objects.closed: Managers can’t see or change payout accounts

objects.name: Tax (PB1 / PPN) & service charge
objects.from: Calculated on every sale from the rates in settings
objects.auto: Tax report
objects.closed: Tax amounts can’t be edited on a transaction

objects.name: Dashboards, P&L & analytics
objects.from: Sales, COGS, expenses, payroll, payables
objects.auto: Owner reports · KPIs
objects.closed: Hidden from managers (only sales and costs they control)

objects.name: Budgets & targets
objects.from: Owner sets; manager can propose for their outlet
objects.approve: Manager proposal → Owner
objects.auto: Target bars on dashboards · alerts when behind
objects.closed: Manager can’t lower their own target

objects.name: Franchise royalties
objects.from: Franchisee sales × contract rate
objects.auto: Royalty invoice
objects.closed: Franchisee can’t edit sales that royalty is based on

objects.name: Assets, equipment & renovation
objects.from: Purchase request or asset register
objects.approve: Purchase / repair request ≤ IDR 500k Manager · above Owner
objects.auto: Depreciation · expense when paid
objects.closed: Asset purchases go through a request; nobody records an asset as bought without approval

objects.name: Customer credit (kasbon)
objects.from: Created at the POS when a known customer pays later
objects.approve: Over limit → Manager · new limit → Owner
objects.auto: Receivables · reminder WA to customer
objects.closed: Cashier can’t give credit to an unknown customer or above the limit

objects.name: Deposits, balance & gift cards
objects.from: Top-up or gift card sold at the POS / online
objects.create: Cashier (paid top-up) · free top-up / gift = comp
objects.edit: Never edited; adjustments are new lines
objects.approve: Free gift card or manual balance: Manager ≤ IDR 500k · Owner above
objects.auto: Balance used at checkout · liability report
objects.closed: No manual balance edit; free value always needs a second person

objects.name: Products & menu (global)
objects.from: Owner adds for all outlets / chosen outlets / one brand
objects.edit: Owner. Outlets can’t delete; they mark 86 or (if allowed) set a local price within ±10%
objects.auto: Synced to POS, QR, kiosk, ride-hailing menus
objects.closed: Managers can only hide a global item at their outlet

objects.name: Outlet-only items (local)
objects.from: Manager adds for their outlet
objects.edit: Manager (draft) · after approval only with owner OK
objects.approve: Always → Owner (keep local or promote to global)
objects.auto: Shows only at that outlet
objects.closed: Franchise lock “Allow outlet-only items” can turn this off

objects.name: Prices & price lists
objects.from: Owner sets; manager requests local price (±10%)
objects.approve: Any manager price change → Owner. Franchise lock “Menu prices” blocks it
objects.auto: Price history kept · ride-hailing price lists sync
objects.closed: POS can’t change list prices; history can’t be edited

objects.name: Recipes & COGS
objects.from: Owner / manager writes the recipe; cost comes from latest purchase prices
objects.approve: Manager change → Owner
objects.auto: Stock deduction per sale · food cost % · margin
objects.closed: COGS is calculated, never typed

objects.name: Sold out (86)
objects.from: Automatic when an ingredient hits 0, or marked by kitchen / PIC / manager
objects.edit: Same people; clears automatically when stock is received
objects.auto: Hidden or marked on POS, QR, kiosk, ride-hailing
objects.closed: Always per outlet; nobody can 86 another outlet

objects.name: Promos, vouchers & flash sales
objects.from: Owner builds (Menu Studio → Pages for visuals)
objects.approve: Manager promo → Owner (it changes prices)
objects.auto: Prices at POS / QR / kiosk · usage report
objects.closed: Voucher codes are single-use per customer unless set; staff can’t redeem for themselves

objects.name: Stock levels & stock card
objects.from: Sales (by recipe), goods receipt, transfers, waste, approved opname adjustments
objects.approve: Only through movements below
objects.auto: Auto-86 · reorder suggestions · valuation
objects.closed: There is no “set stock to X”. Every change is a movement with who, why and when

objects.name: Stock adjustment & waste
objects.from: Kitchen / PIC enter waste or an adjustment with reason and photo
objects.approve: Value ≤ IDR 50k PIC · ≤ 500k Manager · above Owner
objects.auto: Stock movement · waste report · alert if waste is high
objects.closed: Requester can’t approve own; repeated waste on one item is flagged

objects.name: Stock opname (count)
objects.from: Counted on shift per area, blind, with photo per difference
objects.edit: Locked after submit; corrections are recount lines
objects.approve: Variance ≤ IDR 50k PIC · ≤ 500k Manager · above Owner. Counter can’t approve own count
objects.auto: Approved difference becomes “Opname adjustment” movement
objects.closed: Stock only changes on approval; system qty hidden until submit

objects.name: Goods receipt
objects.from: Received at the outlet against a PO or transfer
objects.edit: Locked after confirm; differences go to supplier claim
objects.approve: Emergency buy without PO: receipt photo → Manager
objects.auto: Stock in · supplier bill created · batch & expiry recorded
objects.closed: Can’t receive more than ordered without a note; no receipt, no bill

objects.name: Purchase orders
objects.from: Manager creates, often from automatic reorder suggestions
objects.edit: Draft only; sent POs are locked
objects.approve: ≤ IDR 500k Manager · above Owner. Approver ≠ requester
objects.auto: Sent to supplier by WA · expected stock
objects.closed: Suggestions come from par levels and sales speed, not guesses

objects.name: Transfers between outlets
objects.from: Requested by one outlet, sent by another
objects.edit: Locked after send; receiver confirms qty
objects.approve: Value > IDR 500k → Owner
objects.escalate: Not received in 24 h → both managers
objects.auto: Stock out at sender, in at receiver, in-transit in between
objects.closed: Differences on arrival are flagged, never silently fixed

objects.name: Suppliers
objects.from: Owner adds; manager can propose
objects.approve: Manager proposal → Owner
objects.auto: Price history from POs · price-increase alerts
objects.closed: Managers can’t add a supplier and pay it

objects.name: Batches & expiry
objects.from: Recorded at goods receipt
objects.auto: First-expiry-first-out · waste suggestion
objects.closed: Expiry dates come from the receipt, not typed later

objects.name: Customers
objects.from: Created at checkout (phone), QR orders, sign-ups, reservations
objects.approve: Merge duplicates: Manager
objects.auto: Visit history · segments · loyalty
objects.closed: Customer lists can only be exported by the owner

objects.name: Loyalty points & tiers
objects.from: Earned automatically from paid orders by the rules; removed on refund
objects.edit: Never. Corrections are an adjustment request
objects.approve: Points adjustment: Manager requests with reason → Owner
objects.auto: Tier changes automatically · rewards unlock · WA to member
objects.closed: Staff accounts are flagged and can’t get adjustments; one member on many orders in a shift raises an alert

objects.name: Rewards catalog & rules
objects.from: Owner sets the program
objects.auto: Redemptions happen at the POS / app automatically
objects.closed: Managers can’t create rewards or change earn rates

objects.name: Reviews & feedback
objects.from: Guests (after visit), Google, ride-hailing ratings
objects.edit: Nobody edits a review. Manager / owner reply
objects.remove: Never. Abusive ones can be reported to the platform
objects.auto: Rating trend · service recovery flow
objects.closed: Staff can’t delete or rewrite a review

objects.name: Broadcasts & automations
objects.from: Owner writes; manager can propose
objects.approve: Manager draft → Owner
objects.auto: Sent only to opted-in guests · quiet hours
objects.closed: Opt-out is automatic and can’t be undone by staff

objects.name: Ride-hailing & online orders
objects.from: GoFood, GrabFood, ShopeeFood, web store, QR menu. Each arrives with channel, service tier (Rush · Standard · Saver · Scheduled) and items/prices from the platform
objects.edit: Status only: accept → cooking → ready → picked up. Accept by cashier/PIC (or auto-accept); ready only by a KDS bump. Items, prices and tier come from the platform
objects.remove: Cancel: follows the platform’s rules; reason logged
objects.approve: Reject an incoming order: PIC (reason required) · more than 3 rejects in a shift → Manager
objects.escalate: Not accepted 3 min → PIC → Manager · past ready-by 5 min → PIC → Manager
objects.auto: Ticket to the delivery lane on KDS · stock by recipe · channel sales & commission · platform payout reconciliation
objects.closed: Back office can’t add or change an online order; “ready” can’t be set from the POS to game platform prep metrics

objects.name: Channel settings (auto-accept, prep time, price list)
objects.from: Set once per outlet per channel in Online Orders → Channels
objects.create: Owner (all) · Manager (own outlet: auto-accept, prep time, opening hours)
objects.edit: Same people; price list per channel is owner-only
objects.approve: Channel price list: Owner only · local change within ±10% and blocked by franchise lock “Menu prices”
objects.auto: Platform menu, prices and prep time sync on save · KDS lane routing
objects.closed: Managers can’t undercut or mark up a platform menu on their own; integration tokens are owner-only

objects.name: Busy mode & channel pause
objects.from: Kitchen gets slammed; PIC or manager turns it on from POS, KDS or Online Orders
objects.edit: Ends by itself (max 30 min busy, max 60 min pause) or by PIC/Manager
objects.approve: Reason required · pause over 60 min or more than 3 pauses a day → Manager → Owner
objects.escalate: Pause still on after limit → Manager → Owner
objects.auto: Adds +10–20 min to platform prep time or hides the store on that channel · logged as lost-sales estimate
objects.closed: Nobody can quietly switch off delivery for the night; every pause has a reason, a clock and shows in owner reports

objects.name: Ready-by time, service tier & kitchen lanes
objects.from: Calculated from the platform tier, the channel prep time and kitchen load
objects.create: Nobody. Set when the order is accepted
objects.edit: Never by hand. Busy mode is the only lever (adds time for new orders)
objects.auto: KDS sorts the delivery lane Rush → Standard → Saver, then by ready-by; dine-in keeps its own lane and share
objects.closed: Rush orders can’t jump dine-in tables; nobody hand-edits a ready-by to hide lateness

objects.name: Scheduled orders (fire time)
objects.from: Platform or web store order for a later time
objects.edit: Held automatically, fires to the kitchen at ready-by minus prep time. PIC may fire early with a reason
objects.approve: Fire early more than 15 min: PIC (reason) · over 30 min: Manager
objects.auto: Held queue on POS · ticket appears on KDS at fire time · stock deducts at fire
objects.closed: Early firing to clear the queue is logged and visible; food isn’t made hours ahead

objects.name: Pickup shelf & driver codes
objects.from: Driver arrives with the platform’s pickup code / order ID
objects.create: Platform (code) · KDS bump puts the bag on the shelf slot
objects.edit: Cashier/PIC marks picked up only when the code matches
objects.approve: Hand over without a matching code: PIC PIN + reason
objects.escalate: Driver waiting > 5 min → PIC · bag on shelf > 15 min → PIC → Manager
objects.auto: Shelf slot per platform · “picked up” sent to platform · waiting time in channel report
objects.closed: Bags can’t go to the wrong driver; manual handovers need a second person

objects.name: Reservations & tables
objects.from: Guests book online; staff add walk-ins / phone bookings
objects.approve: Deposit refund follows refund chain
objects.auto: Table status on POS / waiter app · reminder WA
objects.closed: Deposits can’t be kept without a no-show record

objects.name: Employees, roles & PINs
objects.from: Owner / manager invites
objects.create: Owner (any role) · Manager (cashier, kitchen, waiter, PIC at own outlet)
objects.approve: Making someone a manager: Owner
objects.auto: Access to apps follows role
objects.closed: Manager can’t create or deactivate a manager or the owner; nobody edits their own role

objects.name: Roster & PIC
objects.from: Manager builds the week
objects.edit: Manager until published; after that swaps need approval
objects.approve: Swap / leave: Manager
objects.escalate: No PIC on a shift 24 h before → Manager → Owner
objects.auto: Staff get WA · PIC tablet hand-off
objects.closed: Every shift must have exactly one PIC before publish

objects.name: Attendance & timesheets
objects.from: Clock-in / out on POS, PIC tablet or staff phone (PIN + selfie + location)
objects.edit: Correction request by the staff member → PIC / Manager
objects.approve: Correction: Manager. Never your own
objects.auto: Hours feed payroll, overtime and late alerts
objects.closed: Selfie + location stop buddy punching

objects.name: Leave, overtime & swaps
objects.from: Staff request on their phone
objects.approve: Manager · Owner if over quota
objects.auto: Roster and payroll update
objects.closed: Manager can’t approve their own leave

objects.name: Payroll, commission & staff advances
objects.from: Hours, overtime, commission rules, advances, deductions
objects.approve: Manager reviews → Owner approves and pays. Staff advance: Manager ≤ IDR 500k · Owner above
objects.auto: Payslips by WA · bank file
objects.closed: Managers can’t change rates, including their own

objects.name: Outlets, hours & devices
objects.from: Owner creates outlets; manager runs their own
objects.create: Owner (outlet) · Manager (hours, devices at own outlet)
objects.auto: Opening hours drive QR / kiosk / ride-hailing availability
objects.closed: Lost device: owner can sign it out remotely

objects.name: Permission matrix per outlet
objects.from: Roles → Who can do what. Starts from a preset (BorNiz default, Small café, Full-service resto, Franchise outlet); each outlet stores only what differs
objects.edit: Owner (signs with approval PIN) · Manager proposes for own outlet → owner
objects.approve: Every change: Owner approval PIN · logged
objects.auto: Read by POS, PIC, KDS, waiter, Online Orders and manager apps (bn-perms.js): hidden actions disappear, approval actions route to PIC → manager
objects.closed: Owner column and BorNiz admin are locked; owner-only actions (prices, publishing, payroll, profit, billing, users & roles, refunds > 500k) can’t be given to staff, and a manager can at most request them

objects.name: Business settings, limits & locks
objects.from: Owner
objects.edit: Owner. Every change logged and announced to managers
objects.auto: Applies to every device immediately
objects.closed: Approval limits, fraud alerts and the audit log can’t be turned off by managers

objects.name: Audit log
objects.from: Every create, change, approval, login and export
objects.auto: Searchable history for owner (all) and manager (own outlet)
objects.closed: Can’t be edited, deleted or paused by anyone, including the owner

objects.name: Customer-facing design (Menu Studio, Pages, studios)
objects.from: Built in Menu Studio, Brand Studio and the studios with a live preview
objects.create: Owner · Manager (draft for own outlet if allowed)
objects.approve: Manager draft → Owner publishes. Franchise locks decide what outlets may change
objects.auto: Applies to QR menu, kiosk, customer display, receipts, store pages after publish
objects.closed: Managers can save and submit but never publish; contrast check blocks publishing; locked elements (status colours, payment marks, legal lines) can’t be changed

objects.name: WhatsApp (WABA), email & SMS
objects.from: Owner connects the number; templates are approved by Meta; credits are used automatically
objects.approve: Template: Manager draft → Owner → Meta review
objects.auto: Thank-you, receipt, reminder and win-back messages send automatically to opted-in guests
objects.closed: Opt-out and consent are automatic; staff can’t message guests who opted out

objects.name: Notifications
objects.from: Raised by events in every app (see Alerts)
objects.escalate: Per alert, see Alerts → Delivery rules
objects.auto: Bell, push, WA digest by role
objects.closed: Fraud and audit alerts can’t be muted by managers

objects.name: BorNiz subscription & invoices
objects.from: BorNiz billing (plan × outlets, add-ons)
objects.auto: Plan limits apply automatically
objects.closed: Managers can’t change plan or add paid add-ons

objects.name: Barcodes, units & serial numbers
objects.from: Owner / manager set them up for products
objects.auto: Labels print from product data; units convert stock automatically
objects.closed: Serial / IMEI is recorded at receipt and sale, never typed afterwards

objects.name: Queue numbers, laundry tracking, couriers
objects.from: Created from orders at the POS / kiosk / web
objects.auto: Guest sees status on phone / WA / queue screen
objects.closed: Status history is kept; nobody back-dates a pickup

objects.name: Business profile & brands
objects.from: Owner settings
objects.auto: Names, tax ID and logos on receipts and pages
objects.closed: Legal name and tax ID are owner-only

objects.name: Live shift, handover & production log
objects.from: PIC tablet and POS during the shift
objects.approve: Handover signed by outgoing and incoming PIC
objects.auto: Shows on manager live monitor and next shift
objects.closed: Notes can be added, never edited after handover

objects.name: Manager finance view
objects.from: Owner allows a limited finance view per manager
objects.auto: Read-only numbers for the manager’s outlet
objects.closed: Profit, payroll totals and bank stay hidden unless owner allows

objects.name: Reports & exports
objects.from: Calculated from all of the above
objects.auto: Scheduled reports by email / WA
objects.closed: Exports with customer data: Owner only

auto: Comes from what happens at the counter, kitchen, gateway or clock-in. Nobody types it, nobody edits it.
adj: Created by people doing the job in the field. Back office never types it; corrections are a request that someone else approves.
manual: Created here by the role shown. Higher-impact changes wait for approval.
incoming: Arrives from guests, platforms or gateways. You respond or change status; you can’t create or rewrite it.
config: Rules that decide how everything else behaves. Only the role shown can change them.

ladder: Rings up sales, requests voids / refunds / discounts / cash out
Can’t approve anything; can’t see the expected drawer amount
Discount ≤ 20% · void / refund ≤ IDR 100k · cash out ≤ 100k · variance ≤ 50k · waste ≤ 50k
Can’t approve own requests or own counts
Up to IDR 500k on refunds, voids, variance, waste, POs, assets, staff advances · staff & roster · local items (to owner)
Can’t change prices, publish, payroll, bank, limits, suppliers, points; can’t approve own
Owner after 30 min (2 h for non-urgent)
Everything above IDR 500k · prices · publishing · payroll · bank · suppliers · points · limits
Can’t edit transactions, stock numbers, reviews or the audit log
Final. Owner’s own refunds are flagged in the weekly digest
Platform, billing, support access (time-boxed, approved by the owner)
Never sees card data; never changes tenant data without a support ticket
loopholes: Approving from someone else’s open session or shared device
Every approve and reject asks for the approver’s own 6-digit approval PIN, separate from the login password. Checked by the server, locks after 5 wrong tries, logged with the PIN owner.
Every approval checks requester ≠ approver, across PIN switches on a shared device
Splitting to stay under a limit
Limits add up per order and per person per shift; the second request includes the first
Impossible; it becomes a refund with the full chain
Cash refund for a QRIS / card sale
Refund goes to the original method; anything else needs the owner
Removed. Stock only moves through sales, receipts, transfers, waste and approved counts
Transactions are permanent; corrections are linked void / refund records
Closed days are locked; reopening needs the owner and is logged
A bill only exists after goods are received on a PO; new suppliers need the owner
Owner only, 2FA, 24 h hold, WA + email notice
Pay rates are owner-only; managers review, never set
Giving points or balance to friends
Points and balance are automatic; adjustments need the owner; staff accounts are excluded
Cashier using their own member number
One member on many orders in a shift raises an alert to the manager
Receipt photo and category are required
Clock-in needs PIN + selfie + location; corrections go to the manager
They escalate; nothing is ever auto-approved; unanswered at shift end means the request expires
Fraud and audit alerts are always on; only the owner changes limits
Online and ride-hailing orders are incoming only; status changes are logged
Only the owner edits the permission matrix (with approval PIN); managers can only propose; owner-only actions are capped and can’t be unlocked for staff
Pausing a channel to skip work
Busy mode max 30 min, pause max 60 min, reason required; longer or repeated pauses go to manager and owner, with a lost-sales estimate
Ready is only a KDS bump with a timestamp; POS can’t set it
Giving the bag to the wrong driver
Picked up only when the platform’s pickup code matches; otherwise PIC PIN + reason
Channel price lists are owner-only; ±10% and franchise lock still apply
Held until fire time; early fire needs a reason and, over 30 min, the manager
Hand-editing a ready-by to hide lateness
Ready-by is calculated; only busy mode adds time, and only for new orders
Reviews can’t be edited or deleted; reply instead
Owner only; every export is logged
Manager PIN is verified on the device and synced with the original time; flagged in the audit log
